title: CVForge CV data
description: One language's CV content. Store data, not presentation: the renderers compose display strings from these fields.

lang.description: Language of this file. Must match the filename suffix (data/cv-<lang>.yaml).

tagline.description: One line under the name, e.g. 'M.Sc. Computer Science - Machine Learning & Rendering Engineer'.

photo.description: Repo-relative path to the avatar. Omit or null for no photo.

contacts.description: Display order is file order. Entries marked private carry a placeholder here; the real value comes from the gitignored data/private.yaml.

id.description: Join key with private.yaml. Stable across languages.

icon.description: Font Awesome icon name, e.g. 'envelope', 'phone', 'location-dot'. Same name is used by both renderers.

brand.description: true renders from the Font Awesome Brands font (github, linkedin, ...), which has no solid variant.

private.description: How this contact relates to data/private.yaml. 'hidden': the value here is a placeholder, the real one comes from private.yaml, and the whole contact is dropped from the public profile (use for the phone number). 'refine': the value here is real and publishable, and private.yaml supplies a more precise one for applications (use for the location, public 'Karlsruhe, DE' vs. full street address). Omitted: fully public, private.yaml never touches it.

profile.description: Short intro paragraph. Use a folded block scalar (>).

highlights.description: Bullet points. Each is one folded (>) paragraph.

thesis.description: Thesis title only. The 'Thesis:' label is added by the renderer.

grade.description: Grade as a string, e.g. "1.2". Never pre-compose it with a label.

grade_note.description: Qualifies the grade: 'current' renders as 'Current Grade 1.2', 'final' as 'Grade 1.2'.

url_label.description: Text shown for the link. Defaults to the bare host+path if omitted.

skills.description: A LIST of groups, not a mapping - mappings do not guarantee order and order is meaningful here.

level.description: Free text, already in this file's language, e.g. 'native' / 'Muttersprache'.

date.description: QUOTED string, "YYYY" or "YYYY-MM". Precision is inferred from the length: "2021-10" renders as 'Oct 2021', "2023" as '2023'. Unquoted YAML turns 2021-10 into a date object and this will reject it.

dateOrOngoing.description: Same as start, or null/omitted for an ongoing entry (renders as 'Present' / 'heute').

tags.description: Free-form chips shown on the entry. `cvforge check` warns when a tag appears in no skills group, but it is not an error - per-entry tags are legitimately more granular.
